tools.name: start_placement_test
tools.description: Starts a short reading placement test (about 15 multiple choice questions, levels A1 to C1) from SpeakBase's CEFR item bank. The test is for ENGLISH. For any other language it returns a link to SpeakBase's free spoken level test for that language instead. Returns a test_id and 5 short texts with the

tools.name: score_placement_test
tools.description: Scores a placement test started with start_placement_test. Pass the test_id and the answers in question order (letters A to D). Scoring happens on the SpeakBase server; returns a CEFR level (A1 to C1), a 0 to 100 score and a link to the free spoken level test, which measures speaking.

tools.name: get_vocabulary_set
tools.description: Returns a free vocabulary set from the SpeakBase public library (about 2,300 sets written and checked by teachers) for a language pair, optionally filtered by CEFR level and topic, with up to 25 cards (word or phrase and its meaning). Includes a link to study the set with audio and games on SpeakBas

tools.name: speak_with_kate
tools.description: Returns a link that opens a live spoken lesson with Kate, SpeakBase's AI speaking tutor, in the chosen language, optionally in a role-play scenario (job interview, ordering at a cafe, doctor visit, small talk at work and 40 more). tools.name: common_mistakes
tools.description: Returns the mistakes SpeakBase's tutor corrects most often for speakers of one language learning another, counted across real lessons (aggregate counts only, shown when at least 10 different learners contributed and at least 3 per mistake type), plus SpeakBase's false friends or typical mistakes set

tools.name: my_level
tools.description: Signed-in only. Returns the person's CEFR level from their SpeakBase spoken level checks (per language, with fluency, vocabulary, grammar and interaction scores) and the level they set in their profile.

tools.name: my_words_due
tools.description: Signed-in only. Returns how many of the person's saved SpeakBase words are due for spaced-repetition review and up to 20 of them (word and meaning). Answers are not written back; reviewing on SpeakBase updates the schedule.

tools.name: my_recent_corrections
tools.description: Signed-in only. Returns the corrections Kate, the SpeakBase speaking tutor, made in the person's recent spoken lessons: what they said, the better way, and a short tip.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "common_mistakes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns the mistakes SpeakBase's tutor corrects most often for speakers of one language learning another, counted across real lessons (aggregate counts only, shown when enough different learners contribute), plus SpeakBase's false friends or typical mistakes set for the pair and an article where one" → after: "Returns the mistakes SpeakBase's tutor corrects most often for speakers of one language learning another, counted across real lessons (aggregate counts only, shown when at least 10 different learners contributed and at least 3 per mistake type), plus SpeakBase's false friends or typical mistakes set"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
